name: Isoperimetric inequality from IBP + Wirtinger + Parseval

insights: Hurwitz 1901 proof has clean three-layer structure: Analytical -> Algebraic -> Geometric
Wirtinger's inequality reduces to n^2 >= 1 for nonzero integers via Fourier
The arithmetic kernel is purely algebraic - no integrals or measures needed
5 axioms isolate: Fourier decomp, reparametrization, Wirtinger sum, area CS, integral CS
Of the 5 axioms, 3 are proved in existing files (OQ01OQ03 by Aristotle)
The reparametrization axiom is the hardest to eliminate (needs inverse function theorem)
Circle equality C^2 = 4piA is a ring identity; square strict inequality uses pi < 4
